headline: Spain Edge Belgium 2-1 and March into the Semis
whyCareReason: Possession kings against a Belgian side built to disrupt: a quarter-final that decided a semi-final berth.
teaser: Spain converted two clear chances and survived a late Belgian reply to win 2-1 in the quarter-finals.
story:
Spain arrived with the same patient, positional game that carried them through the group and Round of 16. Belgium sat deep, looked for transitions, and made La Roja work for every yard of space.

Spain's midfield eventually found the gaps for a two-goal cushion. Belgium pulled one back late and forced a nervous finish, but Spain's structure held through the final minutes.

At 2-1, the quarter-final was settled. Spain advance as one of the tournament's most coherent teams; Belgium's golden generation exits at the last eight.
stakes: Winner to the semi-finals. Loser goes home after a long knockout road.
rivalryAngle: Spain's possession school against Belgium's athletic counter-punch is a modern European classic.
funFacts: Spain are affectionately known as the La Roja.
Belgium are affectionately known as the Red Devils.
This high-profile match was held at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles on 2026-07-10.

keyPlayers.name: Lamine Yamal

keyPlayers.name: Kevin De Bruyne
keyPlayers.hook: The creative spark expected to make the difference for the Red Devils.

headToHead: Historically, matches between these two nations have always been tightly contested affairs, with tactical discipline proving key.
